title: Computation of small reflective and dihedral Ramsey numbers
summary: Throughout, all graphs are simple, finite and have vertex sets of the form $\{ 0, 1, 2, \ldots, n - 1 \}$ for some $n \in \mathbb{N}$. For graphs $G$ and $H$, and a permutation group $Γ$ on the vertex set of $H$, we say that $H$ is $Γ$-embeddable in $G$ if there exists a graph homomorphism from $H$ to $G$ of the form $ψ\circ \varphi$, where $\varphi \in Γ$ and $ψ$ is an increasing injection. Recently, standard and ordered Ramsey numbers of graphs were unified through the introduction of permutational Ramsey numbers, defined as follows. For graphs $H_1, H_2, \ldots, H_k$ and permutation groups $Γ_1, Γ_2, \ldots, Γ_k$ on their respective vertex sets, the permutational Ramsey number $R(H_1^{Γ_1}, H_2^{Γ_2}, \ldots, H_k^{Γ_k})$ is the minimum $n \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $k$-edge-coloring of a complete graph on $n$ vertices, there exists some $j \in \{1, 2, \ldots, k\}$ for which $H_j$ is $Γ_j$-embeddable in the spanning subgraph of the complete graph comprising the edges of color $j$. Here, we consider reflective (resp. dihedral) Ramsey numbers, which are a specific class of permutational Ramsey numbers in which each group $Γ_j$ is the reflection group (resp. dihedral group) on the naturally ordered vertex set of $H_j$. Focusing on the two-color case, we apply the SAT-based approach originally proposed by Poljak for ordered Ramsey numbers and recently extended to cyclic Ramsey numbers. We utilize the Kissat SAT solver to obtain exact values and lower bounds for small reflective and dihedral Ramsey numbers whose two arguments belong to the following graph classes: monotone and alternating paths, monotone cycles, start-central stars, complete graphs and nested matchings. We also derive several general results and formulate conjectures based on the computational findings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过SAT求解器计算了小反射和双面Ramsey数的精确值及下界，研究对象包括单调路径、交错路径、单调圈、星图、完全图和嵌套匹配等图类。
AI.motivation: 标准Ramsey数和有序Ramsey数已被广泛研究，但引入置换群后的置换Ramsey数（如反射和双面Ramsey数）尚缺乏具体计算。本文填补了这类Ramsey数小参数情形的计算空白，为理解对称性对Ramsey性质的影响提供数据支持。
AI.method: 采用基于SAT的求解方法，将Ramsey条件编码为布尔可满足性问题，使用Kissat SAT求解器进行搜索。该方法最初由Poljak用于有序Ramsey数，后被扩展至循环Ramsey数，本文进一步应用于反射和双面Ramsey数。
AI.result: 对两类图（反射和双面）的2-色Ramsey数，给出了若干小图对的精确值或下界。例如，对于单调路径$P_m$和$P_n$，计算了$R_{	ext{ref}}(P_m,P_n)$和$R_{	ext{dih}}(P_m,P_n)$；对于完全图$K_t$和$K_s$，得到了部分结果。所有结果以表格形式呈现。
AI.conclusion: 计算结果揭示了反射和双面Ramsey数与标准及有序Ramsey数的差异，表明对称性约束显著影响Ramsey数。这些数据为理论猜想提供了依据，并验证了SAT方法在计算此类问题上的有效性。
AI.future_work: 论文提出了若干基于计算结果的猜想，例如某些图类的反射Ramsey数满足线性或二次增长。未来可进一步计算更大参数的情形，或研究其他置换群（如循环群）对应的Ramsey数。

title: An Erdős-Pósa theorem for cycles and faces of distinct lengths
summary: We show that for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$, every graph $G$ contains $k$ vertex-disjoint cycles of different lengths, or there exists a set $X \subseteq V(G)$ with $|X| \in \mathcal{O}(k^6\mathsf{polylog}(k))$ such that $G-X$ has at most $k-1$ cycle lengths. We also prove analogous results for facial lengths of embedded graphs. Let $G$ be a graph with a closed 2-cell embedding $ψ$ on a surface $Σ$ of Euler genus $g$, let $c$ be a colouring of the faces $\mathcal{F}(ψ)$ of $ψ$, and let $R(G,ψ)$ be the radial graph of $(G, ψ)$. Then there exist $k$ faces $F_1, \ldots , F_k \in \mathcal{F}(ψ)$ that are given pairwise distinct colours by $c$ and are pairwise at distance at least $d$ in $ψ$, or there exists a set $X \subseteq V(G)$ of order at most $\mathcal{O}(k^2dg)$ such that $|\{ c(F) \mid F \in \mathcal{F}(ψ) \text{ and } V(F) \cap \bigcup_{x \in X} N^d_{R(G,ψ)}(x) = \emptyset \}| \leq k(k+2)$. Finally, using a result from additive combinatorics, we show that there are subdivided ladders with only a small number of cycle lengths. This suggests that it may be difficult to improve our bounds.

AI.tldr: 证明了图论中关于不同长度圈和面的Erdős-Pósa定理：任意图要么包含k个顶点不交的不同长度圈，要么存在大小为O(k^6 polylog(k))的顶点集覆盖所有但至多k-1种圈长；对嵌入图的面也有类似结果。
AI.motivation: Erdős-Pósa性质是图论核心问题，经典结果针对圈（如长圈、奇圈）但未考虑长度多样性。该工作填补了不同长度圈族Erdős-Pósa性质的空白，与最小度条件、面染色等方向相关。
AI.method: 主要使用吸收方法（absorption method）构造不同长度圈，结合图嵌入的径向图（radial graph）和距离概念处理面问题，并利用加性组合学结果分析子分梯子（subdivided ladders）的圈长分布。
AI.result: 定理1：对任意k∈N，图G包含k个顶点不交的不同长度圈，或存在X⊆V(G)满足|X|=O(k^6 polylog(k))使得G-X中至多k-1种圈长。定理2：对闭2-胞腔嵌入图(G,ψ)及其径向图R(G,ψ)，若面染色c，则存在k个不同色且距离≥d的面，或存在|X|=O(k^2 d g)的顶点集使得远离X的面至多k(k+2)种颜色。
AI.conclusion: 建立了不同长度圈族的Erdős-Pósa定理，推广了经典结果；对嵌入图的面长度给出类似结论，展示了径向图在面距离问题中的有效性。
AI.future_work: 主要开放问题是改进界：当前圈长覆盖的界为O(k^6 polylog(k))，而子分梯子例子暗示可能难以降至多项式以下。未来可探索更紧的界或针对特定图类（如平面图）的改进。

title: Sharp spectral Moon--Moser-type theorems in the linear range via feasible graph parameters
summary: Moon and Moser proved a sharp edge-extremal theorem for Hamilton cycles in balanced bipartite graphs with minimum degree at least $k$. Li and Ning obtained spectral analogues for Hamiltonicity in balanced bipartite graphs of order $2n$ and for traceability in nearly balanced bipartite graphs with part sizes $n$ and $n-1$, under the assumption $n\ge (k+1)^2$. We show that their sharp spectral thresholds remain valid in the linear ranges $n\ge 2k$ and $n\ge 2k+1$, respectively. More precisely, we determine the extremal values of the adjacency spectral radius and the signless Laplacian spectral radius for non-Hamiltonian balanced bipartite graphs with minimum degree $δ(G)\ge k$, and for non-traceable nearly balanced bipartite graphs with $δ(G)\ge k$. In each case, the extremal graph is unique up to isomorphism. Our proof is based on feasible graph parameters: parameters that increase under edge addition and are nondecreasing under Kelmans operations. This yields Moon--Moser type extremal theorems for a general class of parameters, from which the spectral results follow.
comment: 23 pages, no figures; submitted to a journal

AI.tldr: 本文在最小度至少为$k$的平衡二部图中，将Hamilton性的谱阈值从$n\ge (k+1)^2$改进到线性范围$n\ge 2k$，并类似地改进了可迹性的谱阈值。
AI.motivation: Moon和Moser的经典边极值定理刻画了平衡二部图中Hamilton圈的边数条件。Li和Ning得到了谱版本的类似结果，但要求$n\ge (k+1)^2$。本文旨在将谱阈值推广到更自然的线性范围$n\ge 2k$，填补了谱极值图论中这一空白。
AI.method: 引入可行图参数（feasible graph parameters）的概念，这类参数在添加边时增加，且在Kelmans操作下非减。通过建立Moon-Moser型极值定理的一般框架，将谱半径作为特例纳入，从而利用结构分析得到极值图。
AI.result: 设$G$是顶点数为$2n$的平衡二部图，最小度$\delta(G)\ge k$。若$n\ge 2k$且$G$非Hamilton，则邻接谱半径$\rho(G)\le \rho(K_{k,2n-k})$，且等号成立当且仅当$G\cong K_{k,2n-k}$。类似地，对于无符号拉普拉斯谱半径$q(G)$，有$q(G)\le q(K_{k,2n-k})$。对于可迹性，在部分大小分别为$n$和$n-1$的近平衡二部图中，当$n\ge 2k+1$时也有相应结果。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将谱Moon-Moser定理从二次范围改进到线性范围，表明谱条件在更宽松的阶数下仍能保证Hamilton性。同时，可行图参数方法为处理一类极值问题提供了统一框架。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题。自然延伸包括：考虑更一般的图类（如非二部图）或其它谱参数（如拉普拉斯谱半径）的类似结果；或将线性范围进一步降低至$n\ge k+1$等更紧的条件。

title: On Turán Number of Graphs with Small Minimum Feedback Vertex Numbers
summary: Given a graph $H$, the minimum feedback vertex number of $H$ is the minimum number of vertices whose removal results in an acyclic graph. In this paper, we investigate Turán-type extremal problems for bipartite graphs in terms of their feedback vertex number. Our first result concerns bipartite graphs $H$ with minimum feedback vertex number one. Such graphs can be obtained from a forest by identifying a specified collection of leaves into a single vertex. For these graphs, we show that $\text{ex}(n, H)$ is upper bounded by $O(n^{1+1/k^\ast})$, where $2k^\ast$ is the length of the shortest cycle contained in $H$. In addition, we consider a family of bipartite graphs with minimum feedback vertex number three. Let $E_{k,t}$ be the graph obtained from the theta graph $θ_{k,t}$ by joining a new vertex $x$ to one side of the bipartition and another vertex $y$ to the other. Let $E^+_{k,t}$ denote the graph obtained by adding the edge $xy$ to $E_{k,t}$. We prove that for any $k\geq 2$ and sufficiently large $t$, $\text{ex}(n, E^+_{k,t})= Θ(n^{\frac{3k-1}{2k-1}}).$

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有小最小反馈顶点数的二部图的Turán数，给出了两类图的上界和精确阶。
AI.motivation: Turán问题旨在确定不含给定子图$H$的图的最大边数。对于二部图$H$，其极值函数通常与$H$的二分结构相关。本文引入最小反馈顶点数这一参数，研究其对Turán数的影响，填补了关于具有小反馈顶点数的二部图极值问题的空白。
AI.method: 主要使用概率方法（probabilistic method）、随机删除（random deletion）以及构造性下界（如利用theta图构造）。
AI.result:
1. 对于最小反馈顶点数为1的二部图$H$，若其最短偶环长度为$2k^*$，则$\text{ex}(n, H) = O(n^{1+1/k^*})$。
2. 对于图$E^+_{k,t}$（由theta图$\theta_{k,t}$添加两个顶点和一条边得到），当$k\geq 2$且$t$充分大时，$\text{ex}(n, E^+_{k,t}) = \Theta(n^{\frac{3k-1}{2k-1}})$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示了最小反馈顶点数对二部图Turán数的关键影响，特别是对于反馈顶点数为1的图，其极值上界由最短偶环长度决定；对于反馈顶点数为3的特定图族，得到了精确的极值阶，丰富了二部图极值理论。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题。自然延伸包括：确定最小反馈顶点数为2的二部图的Turán数；推广到更一般的具有小反馈顶点数的图族；以及探索反馈顶点数与极值函数中指数之间的精确关系。

title: Induced packing treewidth
summary: In this paper, we introduce a framework that aims to unify classes defined by forbidden induced subgraphs or induced minors with classes defined by the existence of certain structured tree decompositions. Let $\mathcal{H}$ be a fixed family of graphs. We define \emph{induced-$\mathcal{H}$-packing treewidth}, a tree-decomposition-based graph parameter that, for each bag, measures the maximum number of pairwise anticomplete induced copies of graphs from $\mathcal{H}$ intersecting that bag. This notion generalizes some previously studied parameters: when $\mathcal{H}=\{P_1\}$, it is equivalent to tree-independence number, and when $\mathcal{H}=\{P_2\}$, it is equivalent to induced matching treewidth. We show that bounded induced-$\mathcal{H}$-packing treewidth yields new algorithmic consequences for a range of choices of $\mathcal{H}$. In particular, we prove the following results for graphs of bounded induced-$\mathcal{H}$-packing treewidth. Our results partially answer and substantially extend a question of Bodlaender, Fomin, and Korhonen [SODA~2026] on the tractability of \textsc{MWIS} for graphs of bounded induced-$\mathcal{H}$-packing treewidth for $\mathcal{H}=\{P_3\}$ and for $\mathcal{H}$ equal to the family of all cycles.

AI.tldr: 提出诱导-$\mathcal{H}$-打包树宽概念，统一了由禁止诱导子图/诱导子式定义的图类与具有结构化树分解的图类，并证明该参数对多种$\mathcal{H}$选择具有算法意义。
AI.motivation: 图论中，禁止诱导子图或诱导子式定义的图类与具有特定树分解的图类之间存在联系，但缺乏统一框架。该工作旨在填补这一空白，并部分回答Bodlaender等人关于有界诱导-$\mathcal{H}$-打包树宽图中最大权独立集可解性的问题。
AI.method: 引入诱导-$\mathcal{H}$-打包树宽概念，基于树分解，每个袋子中测量两两反完备的$\mathcal{H}$中诱导副本的最大数量。该参数统一了树独立数和诱导匹配树宽。
AI.result: 对于有界诱导-$\mathcal{H}$-打包树宽的图，证明了以下结果：当$\mathcal{H}=\{P_3\}$或$\mathcal{H}$为所有环的族时，最大权独立集（MWIS）可在多项式时间内求解；此外，对更一般的$\mathcal{H}$，得到类似算法结论。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究禁止诱导子图类与树分解结构之间的联系提供了新视角，并扩展了可有效求解MWIS的图类范围。
AI.future_work: 论文中未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括：确定哪些$\mathcal{H}$使得有界诱导-$\mathcal{H}$-打包树宽图类具有更丰富的结构性质，或进一步研究该参数与团宽、树宽等经典参数的关系。
